title: Herdr executor A: the five operations behind the existing seam
description:
The herdr executor's SHAPE: the five operations, and nothing about herdr above
them. This tick lands the seam and the happy path. The four hard guarantees are
separate ticks that build on it.

Implement Executor for herdr behind the SAME interface Phase 1 defined
(internal/reconcile/reconcile.go:57): Start, Inspect, CollectDetail, Cancel,
Dispose. All herdr-specific addressing lives inside JobHandle.handle, the one
open object in the contract (internal/exec/subprocess/record.go:218-223). The
reconciler must learn nothing about panes, workspaces or protocols.

- Start: create the worktree/workspace through herdr and launch the agent.
- Inspect: agent state plus whatever durable evidence exists.
- CollectDetail: read the report and the branch. NOTE: the verdict is derived
  from durable evidence only — see tick 2xu, which owns that guarantee and its
  test. Build the seam so 2xu can assert it.
- Cancel: stop the agent.
- Dispose: tear the workspace down.

Do NOT port ticks' spawn/wait/reconcile/cleanup packages. ticfac's reconciler
already owns waves, adoption, disposition and cleanup. Read those four packages
for the hard-won details (the pane-busy retry, the readiness poll, the refusal
to tear down on an unanswered agent.list) and carry the LESSONS, not the code.

Explicitly OUT of scope, each its own tick, so this one stays reviewable:
- 2xu  the verdict comes from durable evidence, never the substrate
- gwc  wall-clock enforcement
- p6b  the artifact boundary (exclude + collect backstop)
- x6j  a substrate failure is never a verdict
- 5hz  disposal reclaims by identity when the recorded id is stale

acceptance_criteria: A herdr Executor implements Start, Inspect, CollectDetail, Cancel and Dispose; the Executor interface is unchanged and internal/reconcile contains no herdr-specific code, asserted by a test or a grep in CI; every piece of herdr addressing lives inside JobHandle.handle; a real tick runs end to end through this executor — dispatched, worked, collected, disposed — and the run is shown; go test -short -timeout 45m ./... green (make test-short).
closed_reason: The herdr executor exists as internal/exec/herdr behind the unchanged five-operation seam, with its own fake agent for tests. Its seam_test.go asserts the reconciler never imports the herdr side — and caught a real violation at the merge gate: internal/reconcile was importing the execution config wgi had filed under internal/herd. Resolved by moving that config to internal/runconfig rather than weakening the guard, since it is executor-agnostic (internal/profile and the parity tests import it too). Full uncached gate green at 179s.
